_comment: Hand-authored decisions merged into docs/rename-map.json by tools/build-rename-map.mjs.
Every entry is a REGISTERED deviation or a tier-0 human ruling with its evidence.
rewrites: regions the July port reimplemented semantically instead of declaration-by-
declaration (REBUILD_PLAN 6.1 D-R5..D-R14) — every port declaration inside the range
is excused, and every top-level declaration of the listed srcFiles is claimed.

TAAPerspectiveCamera.why: src's own header comment cites 'Source camera: TAAPerspectiveCamera (pretty line 17248-17269) with Halton jitter' — renamed EngineCamera in the port.

_mesh.why: pretty 22183-22184 declares `rect, _mesh, _outlineMesh` for SustainabilityText; sustainabilityScene.ts L154-157 declares the same trio as rect/_textMesh/_outlineMesh — renamed for clarity.

_mesh$5.why: TableGripOverlay module vars `_mesh$5, _uniforms$1` (pretty 18553) -> tableGrip.ts L57-58 `_overlayMesh, _overlayUniforms` — renamed with the overlay prefix.

_uniforms$1.why: second of the TableGripOverlay pair (pretty 18553) — see _mesh$5.

_mesh$4.why: water-bear chain `_mesh$4, _camera, _wiggleSystem, _e$3` (pretty 18715) -> tableGrip.ts L128-130 `_bearMesh, _bearCamera, _wiggleSystem` — same chain, bear prefix.

_texture.why: pretty 18718-18720 `_localOffset, _targetLocalOffset, _texture` -> tableGrip.ts, where the texture slot is _bearTexture (L136) beside the matching offsets.

_uniforms.why: second of the TableGripMicro pair (pretty 18997) — see _mesh$3.

PARTICLE_COUNT.why: footer Particles count const (pretty 28667); src computes it as the class field particleCount = TEXTURE_WIDTH * TEXTURE_WIDTH (footerScene.ts L215) — see also the TEXTURE_HEIGHT collapse.

TEXTURE_HEIGHT.why: source declares TEXTURE_WIDTH and TEXTURE_HEIGHT with the same value; src collapsed both reads onto TEXTURE_WIDTH (footerScene.ts L172, textureHeight = TEXTURE_WIDTH). Registered structural collapse.

plumbing.commonjsGlobal$1: rollup commonjs-interop helper (globalThis probe); no src counterpart by construction
plumbing.getDefaultExportFromCjs: rollup commonjs-interop helper; no src counterpart by construction
plumbing.SplitText: vendor adoption binding (var SplitText = _SplitText after the inlined GSAP registration); src imports SplitText from npm gsap instead (D-R4)
plumbing.fromEntries: Object.fromEntries feature-probe fallback next to Settings; src targets runtimes where the native exists

omitted.GlPositionOffset: never ported: registers the glPositionOffset shader chunk + u_glPositionOffset shared uniform (pretty 30026-30067, init'd in App.init 30198). src carries TAA jitter via EngineCamera only. REGISTERED DEVIATION D-O1 — re-examine if sub-pixel TAA differences ever surface.
omitted.shader: the glPositionOffset chunk's GLSL source string (pretty 30026) — see D-O1.
omitted.ImageExporter: debug capture tool (pretty 30125-30172): renders scene to canvas for export, driven only via window.__debug hooks; not ported (July scope). REGISTERED DEVIATION D-O2.
omitted.GUI: debug parameter panel (pretty 30371-30427), shown only behind a settings flag; not ported (July scope). REGISTERED DEVIATION D-O3.
omitted.fftFrag: Bloom FFT/convolution path shaders (pretty 16353-16424): the convolution branch is not ported — Bloom.ts guards it with a loud throw ('Bloom convolution path not ported (unused by the source site)'). REGISTERED DEVIATION D-O4.

allow_orphans.src/engine/core/SecondOrderDynamics.ts#S: REGISTERED SPLIT D-S1: the source class's _updateNumber branch (scalar path) split into its own class; the vector path keeps the original name. src's own comment records the split.
allow_orphans.src/engine/scenes/coaster.ts#_heroSceneR: module-boundary artifact: the bundle reads the flat-scope heroScene singleton directly; TS modules would import-cycle (coaster <-> heroScene), so webgl.ts injects it via bindHeroScene.
allow_orphans.src/engine/scenes/coaster.ts#bindHeroSce: setter half of _heroSceneRef — see that entry.
allow_orphans.src/engine/scenes/wearableConstants.ts#W: hoisted from WearableGalleryItem's static INNER_ROTATION (pretty 19590, same expression -10*Math.PI/180); shared as a const so frame/rise/table modules can import it without the class.
hoisted from WearableGalleryItem's static INNER_SCALE (pretty 19591, same value 1.2) — see INNER_ROTATION.
allow_orphans.src/engine/scenes/wearableScene.ts#force: ESM import bindings are not assignable (readable-source.md §3.5-③): the bundle writes the flat-scope _forceHasMoved directly (pretty 20268); src exports this setter instead. _forceHasMoved itself maps by identity.
